oneOf.title: effective local configuration
oneOf.description: The document the adapter composition builds and validates at bootstrap, not the file an operator writes. The file carries ca_file and may omit discover_hosts; this schema describes the resolved form, in which the CA is reduced to ca_digest and discover_hosts is always present. See docs/local-kubernetes-cli.md for the on-disk format.

helm_release_reads.description: Helm release reads. off advertises none. metadata advertises revision history and deployed status, read from release-Secret metadata only. redacted_content additionally advertises the recorded values and rendered manifest as safe projections that never carry a stored literal. There is no setting that discloses provider bytes.

pod_logs.description: Advertises pods.logs. Absent means false: the effective document carries it only when true, so a configuration that does not enable it keeps its revision.

pod_exec.description: Advertises pods.exec, a mutation, over the connectors-private/2 write exchange only; the read exchange never lists it. Absent means false: the effective document carries it only when true, so a configuration that does not enable it keeps its revision.

kubeconfig_path_digest.description: Digest of the absolute kubeconfig path the native configuration names; present only when it names one, and then contexts.list is advertised and reads that file alone.

oneOf.title: federated service configuration
oneOf.description: The on-disk document read by --config in the federated service mode.

helm_release_reads.description: Helm release reads. off advertises none. metadata advertises revision history and deployed status, read from release-Secret metadata only. redacted_content additionally advertises the recorded values and rendered manifest as safe projections that never carry a stored literal. There is no setting that discloses provider bytes.

pod_exec.description: Advertises pods.exec when true; the federated service has no write exchange, so it is refused there.

operations.description: Read a bounded page of configured Kubernetes resources.
Read one configured Kubernetes object by name; an absent object is not_found.
Read the configured namespaces that exist in the cluster, each by name; never lists the cluster's namespaces.
Read a bounded page of the ReplicaSets a Deployment controls, each carrying its rollout revision annotation.
Observe EndpointSlice addresses and ports without activating connections.
Observe cluster nodes when host discovery is explicitly enabled.
Read a bounded page of a Helm release's revision records from its own release Secrets.
Read the revision records a Helm release currently marks deployed, without choosing one when the store holds several.
Read a safe projection of the values recorded for one Helm release revision: paths, JSON shapes and digests, never a recorded literal.
Read a safe projection of one Helm release revision's rendered manifest: per-document position, byte length and digest, never manifest text.
Read a bounded tail of one pod container's log in a configured namespace, as timestamped lines; advertised only when pod_logs is configured.

List the contexts of the kubeconfig this local connection was configured with: name, cluster, namespace and the current flag, never a credential or server detail; advertised only when the local configuration names a kubeconfig.

Run one command, given as an argument vector with no shell added, in a named container of a pod in a configured namespace, bounded in time and output; a mutation that needs an approval and is advertised only when pod_exec is configured.
